pr.title: Fixes #192055 avoids view refresh race condition
pr.body:
Refs #192055

The "Element with id is already registered" message has long plagued many extensions, and I've tried to work around it the best I can in the extensions themselves, but while I've been able to get very close (employing a very similar fix) I haven't been able to avoid the race condition when calling `reveal`.

With these changes, I haven't been able to repo the race condition anymore, not through normal loading nor with `reveal` calls.

Hopefully this can land 🙏 @alexr00

reviews.body:
## Pull request overview

Fixes a long-standing TreeView race where `TreeView#reveal` can interleave with debounced refresh / in-flight `getChildren` calls and lead to duplicate handle registration (“Element with id is already registered”), aligning ext host caching/refresh behavior with the expected reveal semantics.

**Changes:**
- Adjust `reveal` to snapshot the refresh cancellation token only after pending debounced refreshes settle, and skip `$reveal` if a new root refresh races with the parent-chain walk.
- Ensure `_resolveTreeNode` drains any debounced refresh that may have landed during `getChildren`, so subsequent cache reads don’t use superseded handles.
- Invalidate `_childrenFetchTokens` for subtree clears across the parent and all descendants, and add focused regression tests for the race scenarios (#192055).

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| src/vs/workbench/api/common/extHostTreeViews.ts | Fixes refresh/reveal and refresh/getChildren concurrency by improving refresh token snapshotting, draining pending refresh before cache reads, and invalidating descendant fetch tokens on subtree clears. |
| src/vs/workbench/api/test/browser/extHostTreeViews.test.ts | Adds regression tests covering reveal-after-root-refresh and stale in-flight getChildren behavior after subtree refresh/token invalidation. |
